'IndependentGeometryR2.spectral_after_convolution' depends on axioms: [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound]
IndependentGeometryR2.spectral_after_convolution.{u_1} {H : Type u_1} [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℂ H]
  [CompleteSpace H] (M : Submodule ℂ H) [CompleteSpace ↥M] (A : H →L[ℂ] H) (hA : ∀ y ∈ M, A y ∈ M) :
  (IndependentGeometryR2.spec M).comp A = ((IndependentGeometryR2.spec M).comp A).comp (IndependentGeometryR2.spec M)
